en.heroTitle: Vermicompost Packaging Sizes — 1 kg, 50 kg & Bulk | Satva
en.heroLead: Choose the right pack for home gardens, nurseries, orchards, agri shops, or bulk farm programmes. Satva Organics offers 1 kg retail packs, 50 kg farmer bags, and bulk supply by enquiry.

sectionsBeforeTable.title: Which Pack Should You Choose?
paragraphs: Home gardeners and trial users usually start with 1 kg. Farms, orchards, and polyhouses typically use 50 kg bags for seasonal application. Dealers and FPOs often order backend cartons or bulk tonnes.
5 kg and 10 kg packs may be introduced for select markets—contact us if your shop or cooperative needs an intermediate size.

faqs.question: Do you sell only 1 kg and 50 kg?
faqs.answer: Those are our standard packs today. Bulk loose/tonne supply and custom branding are available for qualified buyers—see pan-India supply.

faqs.question: Can I order one 50 kg bag for my orchard?
faqs.answer: Yes. Many orchard owners start with a few bags. Share your district for freight and availability.

faqs.question: Is 1 kg enough for a kitchen garden?
faqs.answer: Usually yes for a small bed or several pots. For larger terrace gardens, consider 2–3 kg or a 50 kg bag if you share with neighbours.
